user.title: Connect to Kinekt
user.description: In the Kinekt app, open Family → Home Assistant, choose what your family will see, and pair. Paste the pairing code it shows here. Home Assistant reaches out to Kinekt; nothing connects into your home.

data_description.credential: Shown once in Kinekt after pairing. If it's lost, disconnect in Kinekt and pair again.
data_description.api_url: Leave as it is unless Kinekt told you otherwise.

reauth_confirm.title: Pair Kinekt again
reauth_confirm.description: This connection was disconnected in Kinekt. Any scheduled lights have been put back. Pair again in Kinekt (Family → Home Assistant) and paste the new code.

error.bad_code: A pairing code is 64 letters and numbers. Copy the whole code from Kinekt.
error.bad_server: Use the server's https:// address only, with nothing after it.
error.invalid_code: Kinekt didn't accept this code. It may have been disconnected: pair again in Kinekt and paste the new code.
error.cannot_connect: Couldn't reach Kinekt. Check this Home Assistant's internet connection and try again.

abort.already_configured: This pairing is already set up.
